description: This file contains the implementation of the Mail::Address Perl module, which provides functionality for parsing, extracting, and formatting email addresses and related information. It defines the Mail::Address class with methods for parsing email address strings, extracting names, host and user parts, and formatting address lists.

classes.name: Mail::Address
classes.description: A class representing an email address with methods for parsing, extracting components like name, host, user, and formatting.

methods.name: Version
methods.description: Returns the version of the Mail::Address module.

methods.name: _extract_name
methods.description: Private method to extract a person's name from a comment string.

methods.name: _tokenise
methods.description: Private method to tokenize an address string into components for parsing.

methods.name: _find_next
methods.description: Private method to find the next token of interest in the token list.

methods.name: _complete
methods.description: Constructs a Mail::Address object from parsed phrase, address, and comment components.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor method for creating a new Mail::Address object.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an email address string into its components and returns a list of Mail::Address objects.

methods.name: phrase
methods.description: Getter/setter for the phrase (display name) part of the address.

methods.name: comment
methods.description: Getter/setter for the comment part of the address.

methods.name: set_or_get
methods.description: Generic method to set or get a specific component (phrase, address, comment).

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a list of address components into a string suitable for email headers.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Extracts the person's name from the phrase or address, applying formatting rules.

methods.name: host
methods.description: Returns the hostname part of the email address.

methods.name: user
methods.description: Returns the user part of the email address.
